task.title: Be in bed with lights off by 23:30 on 5 of 7 nights
task.description: Keep a 23:30 lights-off time on at least 5 nights this week.
task.why_it_matters: A consistent bedtime is the first lever to test before changing anything else.
task.expected_result: A 7-night log with at least 5 nights at or before 23:30.

expected_output.message_to_user: There's no fair way to prove a bedtime, so this one runs on a quick morning log — lights-off time and how rested you feel. If you already use a sleep tracker, you can attach its export, but it's optional. It counts as self-reported progress.

methods.instructions: Each morning, log the previous night.
Optional sleep-tracker export if you already use one.

protocol.rationale: Bedtime can't be verified objectively without intrusive measures; a same-morning log is the right level and is labelled limited.

contrastive.critique: A nightly photo of a clock proves nothing about when the user went to bed, adds friction to a habit task, and claims more confidence than a photo can support.

output.message_to_user: Every night, send a photo of your clock showing the time before 23:30.

methods.instructions: Photo of a clock showing the time each night.
